{{Article header|deck=A defensive utility module that disrupts gimballed and turreted weapon tracking, doing nothing against fixed weapons.

The '''Chaff Launcher''' deploys a burst of signal-disrupting chaff that confuses the tracking systems used by gimballed and turreted weapons.

== Overview ==

Because chaff specifically interferes with the sensor-assisted tracking that gimballed and turreted mounts depend on, it has no effect against fixed weapons, which a pilot aims manually. A Chaff Launcher is a short-duration defensive tool with limited charges and a cooldown between uses, best timed to cover a vulnerable moment — a turn, a low-shield window, or an escape attempt — rather than run continuously.

{{Field note|Chaff protects against tracking-dependent weapons only. It is not a substitute for [[Electronic Countermeasure]], which instead defends against missiles, torpedoes, and Hatch Breaker limpets.}}
